subject: Export hanging on large workspace again
body:
Hi Priya,

Wanted to flag - export has been timing out for us for a couple weeks now on our main workspace (the ~80k row one). Support said this was a known issue.

Chris

subject: Re: Export hanging on large workspace again
body:
Hi Chris,

Thanks for flagging, sorry for the trouble. Our eng team is aware and actively working a fix for large workspaces specifically (yours is one of our biggest). I'll loop in Jordan on timing.

Priya

subject: Export fix timeline
body:
Hi Chris,

Following up from Priya's note - I checked with engineering and we're targeting September 5th to have the large-workspace export timeout fully resolved. I'll personally confirm once it's out.

Appreciate your patience, especially given how much you rely on export for your workflow.

Jordan

subject: Export v2 GA this week
body:
Team,

Planning to announce export v2 as GA this week (background jobs, json export, progress bar). QA has signed off on small/medium workspaces. Sarah flagged large-workspace behavior as a follow-up item, tracking separately so it doesn't block the announcement. Will post in #eng once it's live.

Emily

subject: Export still broken - you said this shipped
body:
Hi team,

Following up again. Jordan told us on August 25th that the export timeout would be fixed by September 5th. Then last week (September 3rd) we saw the announcement that export v2 had shipped, so we tried again on our full workspace - it is still timing out, exact same behavior as before.

You told us this shipped last week. At this point we need a real answer, not another announcement. We're also now discussing whether this affects our renewal.

Chris Whitfield
Northstar Analytics

subject: Re: Export still broken - you said this shipped
body:
Hi Chris,

I'm very sorry - you're right, and I want to be straight with you this time instead of giving another premature timeline. The specific large-workspace timeout you're hitting is still open on our end (tracked internally as ENG-412), there's a fix in code review right now. I will not say 'fixed' again until it's verified against a workspace your size. Setting up a call for tomorrow to talk through options in the meantime, including on the renewal.

Jordan

subject: Northstar situation
body: Marcus - saw the thread with northstar. Can we get a real fix + verification plan by EOW, not just another 'shipped' announcement? This is a renewal risk. Let's sync tomorrow.\n\nTom

subject: Re: Northstar situation
body: Yep - sarah's PR (#288) adds pagination to the export job, that's the actual fix. Holding the merge until we verify against a dataset closer to northstar's size, don't want to repeat the same mistake. Should have a real answer by wednesday.\n\nMarcus

Best,
Amir

body:
Hi there,

Yes, custom delimiters (comma/semicolon/tab) have been supported since v1.4 - you can set this under Export Settings > Format. Let me know if you run into any issues.

Nora

body: Thanks Jordan, appreciate the specific date. We'll plan to re-test on our end once you confirm it's live.\n\nChris

subject: PR 288 review notes
body: Hey - reviewing #288 now. Pagination logic looks right, left a couple small comments. Did you get a chance to test against something closer to northstar's actual row count? Want to make sure we're not re-announcing this before it's really solid.\n\nDavid

subject: Re: PR 288 review notes
body: Good call - only tested up to 60k synthetically so far, northstar's around 80k. Spinning up a bigger test fixture today before we merge, want this actually verified this time.\n\nSarah

subject: Northstar renewal risk
body: Flagging northstar's renewal (in ~6 weeks) is now at risk given the repeated export issues and the 'shipped' miscommunication. Want to make sure we don't over-promise again before #288 is actually verified.\n\nJordan
